scope: Qwen3.5-4B BF16 on Ascend910B3; B64 client concurrency; 384 cached tokens plus 128 continuation tokens and 16 output tokens per request
data_contract: All client timing values and cache-hit counts are preserved. Output token IDs and text hashes are omitted. Forward shapes and path counts come from NPU Event stream records.
aggregation: Wall and throughput speedups use per-mode medians across four batches per trial. TTFT speedups use the median across all 64 requests per batch. No outlier rounds are removed.
path_contract: Both arms use the same engine and kernel. RID-based instrumentation disables the pool gate for legacy and asserts pool selection for pool. Every recorded extend forward has 24 GDN layer calls and one state copy; copy_temporal is true only for legacy.
notes: chunk128 and chunk1024 have two independent trials; chunk512 has one trial.
chunk1024_trial1 legacy round_index=2 has wall_ms=6261.85963 and is retained; median rather than mean wall speedup is used for the PR summary.
B64 is client concurrency, not the GDN operator batch size; actual forward shapes are recorded per trial.
